title: Hybrid and Async Part 107 Prep for Schools
sub_heading: Weekly pacing patterns for BYOD classrooms, block schedules, and workforce cohorts that cannot meet daily.
body_html:
Draft — review before import. Add screenshots when available.

In short: Part 107 prep does not require every student in the same seat every day. Browser-based units support homework-first, lab-first, or fully async workforce models—with the manager dashboard flagging who fell behind.

Sample weekly rhythm (teacher-led hybrid)

  • Mon: Introduce unit concept in class; assign two sections async
  • Wed: Review missed practice items; section quiz in class
  • Fri: Unit exam milestone or flight lab (optional hardware)

Block schedule variant

Long periods suit flight or sim lab; async sections assigned between block days. Dashboard check every block for completion gaps.

Workforce / community college

Fully async with weekly manager office hours. Success metric: steady section completion rate, not synchronized class bells.

BYOD and access

No app install; students need reliable browser access. Districts set device and privacy policies; share Privacy Notice with IT early.
